activity.notes: Majorian (Iulius Valerius Maiorianus) was Western Roman emperor from 457 to 461. Ancient and modern reconstructions distinguish his elevation/proclamation and later eastern recognition at day-level, so ATLAS keeps the authoritative and undisputed year-level reign instead of forcing one contested accession day.

sources.title: Majorian — Encyclopaedia Britannica (1911)
sources.citation_text: Britannica identifies Majorian as emperor of the West from 457 to 461.

sources.title: Majorian — De Imperatoribus Romanis
sources.citation_text: The scholarly Roman-emperors reference discusses Majorian's western imperial rule in 457–461 and the differing accession/recognition chronology.
